subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------TR.
description: Diagram in PCC-17. C-INFO (composite information) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what composite information's relationship to transformation looks like. C-INFO → TR (the crossing). Two lines branch from the main line. One runs to PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), from which T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches. The other runs to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), which branches to EXT-FT (extended functionalism) and MT-INFO (multi-information). DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) branch from MT-INFO, and EXT-INFO-B and (R)DIFF both branch from AFL-DY.
